soru: Bulut hizmetlerinde olay yönetimi için kök neden analizi (hata konumlandırma, nedensellik çıkarımı) yöntemleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Bulut hizmetlerinde olay yönetimi için kök neden analizi (hata konumlandırma, nedensellik çıkarımı) yöntemleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-09-22. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Automatic Root Cause Analysis via Large Language Models for Cloud Incidents
calismalar.gerekce: RCACopilot is an LLM-based system deployed at Microsoft that collects diagnostic data and predicts the root-cause category of cloud incidents; it is a key reference for LLM-driven RCA.

calismalar.baslik: Recommending Root-Cause and Mitigation Steps for Cloud Incidents using Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: The first large-scale study of using LLMs to generate root causes and mitigation steps, covering more than 40,000 Microsoft incidents.

calismalar.baslik: Causal Inference-Based Root Cause Analysis for Online Service Systems with Intervention Recognition
calismalar.gerekce: CIRCA gave RCA a theoretical footing by framing it as causal 'intervention recognition'.

calismalar.baslik: Root Cause Analysis of Failures in Microservices through Causal Discovery
calismalar.gerekce: RCD (NeurIPS 2022) treats a failure as an intervention and uses localized, hierarchical causal discovery to find the root cause in a scalable way.

calismalar.baslik: Root Cause Analysis for Microservices based on Causal Inference: How Far Are We?
calismalar.gerekce: A broad empirical comparison of 9 causal discovery methods and 21 RCA methods, showing that no single method wins and that results on synthetic data do not carry over to real systems.

calismalar.baslik: Localizing Failure Root Causes in a Microservice through Causality Inference
calismalar.gerekce: MicroCause is the foundational metric-level causal RCA method, combining a PC-algorithm variant that accounts for time lags with random walk.

calismalar.baslik: CloudRanger: Root Cause Identification for Cloud Native Systems
calismalar.gerekce: An early, influential work for cloud-native systems that set the template of building a causal graph with PC and then running a random walk.

calismalar.baslik: MicroRCA: Root Cause Localization of Performance Issues in Microservices
calismalar.gerekce: A widely used baseline that locates root-cause services in real time using an attributed graph of services and hosts plus personalized PageRank.

calismalar.baslik: Eadro: An End-to-End Troubleshooting Framework for Microservices on Multi-source Data
calismalar.gerekce: The first end-to-end framework to learn anomaly detection and root-cause localization jointly from traces, logs and metrics.

calismalar.baslik: Nezha: Interpretable Fine-Grained Root Causes Analysis for Microservices on Multi-modal Observability Data
calismalar.gerekce: Provides interpretable root causes at the code-region and resource-type level from multi-modal observability data.

calismalar.baslik: Actionable and Interpretable Fault Localization for Recurring Failures in Online Service Systems
calismalar.gerekce: DejaVu brought supervised, interpretable fault localization for recurring failures, using graph neural networks over the system's dependency graph.

calismalar.baslik: MicroRank: End-to-End Latency Issue Localization with Extended Spectrum Analysis in Microservice Environments
calismalar.gerekce: A key trace-based RCA method that combines spectrum analysis with PageRank.

calismalar.baslik: RCAgent: Cloud Root Cause Analysis by Autonomous Agents with Tool-Augmented Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: A privacy-conscious, tool-using LLM agent for RCA, deployed on Alibaba Cloud's Flink platform.

calismalar.baslik: OpenRCA: Can Large Language Models Locate the Root Cause of Software Failures?
calismalar.gerekce: A benchmark of 335 real failures with 68 GB of telemetry, showing that LLMs locate root causes poorly (around 11% success).

calismalar.baslik: AIOpsLab: A Holistic Framework to Evaluate AI Agents for Enabling Autonomous Clouds
calismalar.gerekce: Provides a fault-injection environment and a standard benchmark for evaluating AI agents on detection, localization and RCA tasks.

calismalar.baslik: BARO: Robust Root Cause Analysis for Microservices via Multivariate Bayesian Online Change Point Detection
calismalar.gerekce: Combines anomaly detection and RCA so that results stay robust when anomaly detection is inaccurate.

calismalar.baslik: RCAEval: A Benchmark for Root Cause Analysis of Microservice Systems with Telemetry Data
calismalar.gerekce: An open benchmark of 735 failure cases and 15 reproducible baselines, aimed at the field's evaluation and reproducibility problem.

calismalar.baslik: Sage: Practical & Scalable ML-Driven Performance Debugging in Microservices
calismalar.gerekce: Finds root causes of QoS violations without labeled data, using causal Bayesian networks and counterfactual reasoning.

calismalar.baslik: Groot: An Event-graph-based Approach for Root Cause Analysis in Industrial Settings
calismalar.gerekce: An event-graph-based RCA experience report deployed across 5,000 services at eBay and evaluated on 952 real incidents.

calismalar.baslik: CloudRCA: A Root Cause Analysis Framework for Cloud Computing Platforms
calismalar.gerekce: An industrial cloud RCA framework deployed at Alibaba that combines KPIs, logs and topology in a knowledge-informed hierarchical Bayesian network.

calismalar.baslik: Anomaly Detection and Failure Root Cause Analysis in (Micro)Service-Based Cloud Applications: A Survey
calismalar.gerekce: An ACM Computing Surveys review that classifies anomaly detection and RCA techniques for service-based cloud applications and lays out open challenges.

calismalar.baslik: Failure Diagnosis in Microservice Systems: A Comprehensive Survey and Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: A comprehensive survey of about 98 papers that compiles microservice failure-diagnosis methods, datasets, tools and metrics.

calismalar.baslik: Exploring LLM-based Agents for Root Cause Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: An empirical evaluation of a ReAct agent on real Microsoft incidents, documenting the gains in factual accuracy and the limits of LLM agents.

calismalar.baslik: How to Fight Production Incidents? An Empirical Study on a Large-scale Cloud Service
calismalar.gerekce: A best-paper empirical study of the causes of high-severity production incidents and the delays in detection, root-causing and mitigation.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Intelligent Incident Management: Why We Need It and How We Make It
calismalar.gerekce: Describes incident management challenges at Microsoft and the AIOps framework built to address them, motivating intelligent incident management.

calismalar.baslik: Practical Root Cause Localization for Microservice Systems via Trace Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: TraceRCA is a practical trace-based method that ranks suspicious service sets by their ratio of abnormal to normal traces; it was deployed in production at a bank.

calismalar.baslik: Murphy: Performance Diagnosis of Distributed Cloud Applications
calismalar.gerekce: A SIGCOMM 2023 system that models loosely coupled entities and their cyclic interactions with a Markov random field for performance diagnosis.

calismalar.baslik: Root Cause Analysis in Microservice Using Neural Granger Causal Discovery
calismalar.gerekce: RUN brings temporal causal discovery to RCA through neural Granger causality and contrastive learning.

calismalar.baslik: mABC: multi-Agent Blockchain-Inspired Collaboration for root cause analysis in micro-services architecture
calismalar.gerekce: A multi-agent LLM framework that reduces hallucination in RCA through voting among multiple agents.

calismalar.baslik: Flow-of-Action: SOP Enhanced LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Root Cause Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: Constrains LLM agents' actions with standard operating procedures taken from SRE practice, addressing irrelevant actions and hallucination in ReAct-based RCA.
